title: Probability
preview: Likelihood of events, relative and theoretical probability, comparing probabilities of simple events, and simulations.
description: Indiana standards 7.DSP.4, 7.DSP.5. Students reason about likelihood on a 0-to-1 scale, build probability models for simple events, and run simulations.

sections.label: 10-1 Find Likelihood
sections.description: Place events on the 0-to-1 likelihood scale (impossible / unlikely / equally likely / likely / certain).

sections.label: 10-2 Relative Frequency of Simple Events
sections.description: Compute relative frequency from observed data.

sections.label: 10-3 Theoretical Probability of Simple Events
sections.description: Build probability models with sample spaces and equally-likely outcomes.

sections.label: 10-4 Compare Probability of Simple Events
sections.description: Compare theoretical and relative-frequency probabilities; explain discrepancies.

sections.label: 10-5 Simulate Chance Events
sections.description: Design and run simulations to estimate probabilities.
